description: [1/3] Plan: adversarial defect hunt on the public API - found and fixed a quadratic/O(n^4) texture preset cost with an unbounded allocation, and a lock bypass where set_node and set_selection_properties mutated locked nodes

impact_assessment.why: TextureData.pattern ran per-pixel Python loops (panel 180ms, rivets 288ms at 512x512, rivets O(size^4)) with no size bound, and a locked editor node could still be renamed, re-layered, re-tagged, hidden or bulk-edited because two handlers omitted the guard their siblings call.
impact_assessment.benefits: Procedural textures are linear in pixel count with a 16 MB ceiling; an editor lock now blocks every mutation path rather than most of them.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: lock now rejects two more actions; dependency: none new; concurrency: none; state: no persisted format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Prove pixel-identical output for the perf rewrite against a reference implementation, extend the lock regression to enumerate the new paths, and verify no suite test relied on the permissive behaviour.

description: [2/3] Both fixes implemented and verified - texture presets proven pixel-identical across 9 sizes (including odd ones) with panel 180ms->2ms and rivets 288ms->6.5ms at 512x512 plus a 2048 size ceiling; lock matrix shows all 13 mutating actions now blocked; play matrix shows all 15 blocked; probes confirmed PNG round-trips, corrupt-PNG rejection, atomic writes, non-finite JSON rejection and undo/redo/batch/prefab-edit integrity all correct

[3/3] Project gate 6/6 on both commits; 986 tests 0 failures; canonical --simulate hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and reference PNG 4899B unchanged; pushed 1c34cd4 and 6b27f81; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan: fixed the WAV encode/decode asymmetry found by an adversarial IO probe - read_wav scaled negatives by 32768 and positives by 32767 while write_wav scaled both by 32767, so every negative sample drifted one step toward zero on round trip and -1.0 decoded as -0.99997

impact_assessment.why: The error is asymmetric distortion, not quantization, and the existing round-trip test compared one positive sample at places=2 so it could not detect it.
impact_assessment.benefits: WAV round-trips are symmetric and full-scale values are exact; audio evidence and hashes are trustworthy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: decoded sample values change by up to one step; dependency: none new; concurrency: none; state: no file format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Divide both signs by 32767 and clamp for the external -32768 case, prove the odd-symmetry invariant with a regression, and run the full 6/6 gate.

description: [2/3] Fixed and verified - read_wav divides both signs by 32767 and clamps to [-1,1]; negatives and positives now carry identical error magnitude and +/-1.0 round-trips exactly; regression asserts the odd-symmetry invariant plus a one-step bound; 1000 tests pass; canonical hash unchanged; 6/6 gate; pushed 4509abd

[3/3] Additional probes found no defects: physics/character (floor rest, jump, wall stop, determinism), triggers (enter/stay/exit/teleport), broadphase vs brute force over 60 queries, raycast nearest+filter, glTF import and rejection, material graph evaluation and cycle/dangling rejection, scene and prefab library round-trips with trash restore, headless and UI render determinism, and Engine cleanup on build_scene/bind_input failure; checklists: passed
